matchups.recap: Lil Fridge started Bryce Young for 7.42 while Caleb Williams sat on the bench with 22.12, a swap that would have flipped this one. Return of T Mac took the upset anyway, and the other side's Christian McCaffrey is now listed Questionable. Both sides started a recent add: Bijan Robinson posted 14.7 after his trade, while the free agent pickup Courtland Sutton managed 6.

Brock ‘N’ Roll beat Maye d'force B with U 85.87 to 81.19 in an upset, and both sides needed a season low to get there. The winners' recent adds barely showed up, with Chris Godwin Jr. at 4.7 and the new pickup Jets defense at -0.55. Jalen Coker, Jahmyr Gibbs and the Niners defense all blew it for the losing side, and Jaylen Waddle is now listed Questionable.

Unsolicited Dak Picks won 106.12 to 91.65 in an upset, climbing past a side that sat above them before the week. Caleb Douglas, the new pickup, outscored the margin on his own with 20, and fellow recent add Josh Jacobs chipped in 17.6. At least CeeDee Lamb showed up for behold the lamb, and Saquon Barkley is now listed Questionable.

Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team flattened London Cooking 148.13 to 98.15 in an upset, with the 9th-place side mauling the 2nd-place side. The trade desk tells the story: recent add Tony Pollard put up 35, while the new pickup Nico Collins gave his new team 1.6. To top off the week, Woody Marks, Drake London and Amon-Ra St. Brown are all now listed Questionable.

Turns out all you need is Joe Burrow: his 28.88 outscored the margin on his own as All You Need Is Love beat Bo Girds in an upset. Devaughn Vele, the new pickup, chipped in 13.9 for the losing side, and they still dropped a 3rd straight. On the winning side, Aaron Jones Sr. is now listed Questionable.

To Infinity and Bijan went infinitely backwards, falling 122.5 to 106.32 to Pukancun on 3 in an upset. Their recent adds flopped: the Titans defense, a free agent add, finished at -0.7, and Jaylin Noel, now listed Questionable, scored 0.7. On the other side, the trade pickup Cam Skattebo outscored the margin on his own and is now listed Questionable.

blurbs.motw: Return of T Mac knocked off first-place Lil Fridge 101.61 to 89.77 in an upset. Bryce Young finished dead last among started QBs while Caleb Williams sat on the bench with 22.12, enough to flip the result. Brutal lineup call. Bijan Robinson, a recent add by trade, scored 14.7 and still outscored the margin on his own. Courtland Sutton, the recent add on the losing side, managed 6. Christian McCaffrey put up 19 for the league leaders and is now listed Questionable.

Douglas outscored the margin on his own, so without him, that is a loss. The lamb in question, CeeDee Lamb, posted 21.9 for the losing side anyway. Saquon Barkley, also on that roster, is now listed Questionable.

Their new pickup Caleb Douglas took the Game Changer anyway, scoring 20 on a 6.25 projection. London Cooking got 1.6 out of Nico Collins on a 14.46 projection, good for the Underperformer.
